conversionInteraction.note: LTC premiums count as medical expenses subject to the 7.5%-of-AGI floor. A conversion raises AGI and therefore SHRINKS the medical deduction - a real marginal cost. The reverse is the late-life planning play in Gemini Findings 2 section 8 phase 3: a year with very large deductible medical or LTC costs can absorb a large conversion cheaply. The engine should surface high-medical-expense years as conversion opportunities.
